en.description:
Turn the Digital Crown and bring a classic slot machine experience to your wrist.

Lucky Crown is a fast and easy-to-play slots game designed for Apple Watch. Spin three reels, match classic symbols, collect coins, and unlock free spins wherever you go.

CLASSIC SLOT ACTION

Enjoy colorful reels featuring cherries, gold bars, bells, diamonds, lucky sevens, Wilds, and Scatters. Match symbols across paylines to grow your coin balance.

SPIN WITH THE DIGITAL CROWN

Control every spin naturally with the Digital Crown. Reel animations and haptic feedback make each result feel satisfying right on your wrist.

LAND SCATTERS AND EARN FREE SPINS

Find three or more Scatter symbols to receive five free spins. Additional Scatters can keep the free-spin streak going.

FEATURES

• A slot game designed specifically for Apple Watch
• Quick spins using the Digital Crown
• Classic 3×3 reels and recognizable slot symbols
• Wild and Scatter mechanics
• Free-spin bonuses
• Adjustable bet levels
• A daily coin bonus
• Haptic feedback for reel stops and wins
• Automatic progress saving
• Support for Reduce Motion

Spin the reels, collect coins, and see how lucky your crown can be.

Lucky Crown is intended for entertainment purposes only. It does not offer real-money gambling, cash prizes, or real-world rewards.
